steps.code:
# Import all markdown files as notes, skipping already existing titles
existing_titles = {'Book Reading Lists'}
for file_path in files:
    basename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    title = basename[:-3].replace('_', ' ')
    if title in existing_titles:
        print(f"Skipping existing note: {title}")
        continue
    file_info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
    content = file_info['content']
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    print(f"Created note for {basename}: {result}")
    existing_titles.add(title)
